rows.grounds: compound denoting the seed-mantra of fire
instrumental indicating accompaniment in ritual application
specifies the deity to whom the limbs belong
ritual act of uniting mantra elements

items.question: What ritual joining must be effected between the fire-seed and the six limbs of fire?
premises: The fire-seed is the mantra element to be ritually applied.
The six limbs are associated with fire in this procedure.
The prescribed action requires effecting a joining of these elements.
items.inference: The practitioner should effect the joining of the fire-seed with the six limbs of fire.
uncertainties: The specific bīja syllable for fire is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should effect the joining of the fire-seed with the six limbs of fire.
